g.title: pause
g.text: Game paused (clock stops, board hidden, saved)
Lock screen put under the cover, if on
Black cover on the system layer

g.title: analog
g.text: hands each second, moved each minute,

g.title: stars
g.text: Starfield: stars rushing past as streaks,
speed surging and calming in waves, 25 fps,

g.title: mandel
g.text: Mandelbrot: a zoom into the set,
next level made on the worker core
about 12 fps, CPU at full speed

g.title: boids
g.text: flocks; red hawks), fading trails, 25 fps,

g.title: attr
g.text: drawn point by point for 2 minutes,

g.title: a3d
g.text: in a turning 32 x 32 x 32 cube of blocks

g.title: life
g.text: A cellular automaton on 120 x 120 dots
(Game of Life, Brian's Brain, Langton's ant,
cyclic spirals, rock paper scissors, excitable medium,
Day & Night, Seeds, Maze, Star Wars, forest fire),

g.title: wake
g.text: On press: full speed, panel awake, light on
